---
title: "Projects"
subtitle: "This repository showcases the write-ups of the analysis, mapping and modelling work that I have done."
listing:
  # `grid` = cards with thumbnails. Other options: `default`, `table`.
  type: grid
  grid-columns: 2
  # Every project lives in its own folder as `index.qmd`.
  contents: "*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: [date, title]
  filter-ui: true
  fields: [image, date, title, description, reading-time, categories]
  image-height: "260px"
  feed: true                   # generates projects/index.xml (RSS)
page-layout: full
title-block-banner: false
format:
  html:
    toc: false
    code-tools: false   # hides the "</> Code" button inherited from _metadata.yml
---
